mapper.insert: MERGE INTO BOK_SUBJECT a USING ( SELECT #{booksetId} BOOKSET_ID, #{subjectNo} SUBJECT_NO, #{subjectName} SUBJECT_NAME, #{fsubjectId} FSUBJECT_ID, #{subjectType} SUBJECT_TYPE, #{subjectLevel} SUBJECT_LEVEL, #{balFlag} BAL_FLAG, #{dataSource} DATA_SOURCE, #{status} STATUS, #{remark} REMARK, #{errMsg} ERR_MSG, #{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.BOOKSET_ID = b.BOOKSET_ID AND a.SUBJECT_NO = b.SUBJECT_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.SUBJECT_NAME = b.SUBJECT_NAME, a.FSUBJECT_ID = b.FSUBJECT_ID, a.SUBJECT_TYPE = b.SUBJECT_TYPE, a.SUBJECT_LEVEL = b.SUBJECT_LEVEL, a.BAL_FLAG = b.BAL_FLAG, a.STATUS = b.STATUS, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.ERR_MSG = b.ERR_MSG, a.UPDATE_USER = b.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(BOOKSET_ID,SUBJECT_NO,SUBJECT_NAME,FSUBJECT_ID,SUBJECT_TYPE,SUBJECT_LEVEL,BAL_FLAG,DATA_SOURCE,STATUS,REMARK,ERR_MSG,CREATE_USER,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(b.BOOKSET_ID,b.SUBJECT_NO,b.SUBJECT_NAME,b.FSUBJECT_ID,b.SUBJECT_TYPE,b.SUBJECT_LEVEL,b.BAL_FLAG,b.DATA_SOURCE,b.STATUS,b.REMARK,b.ERR_MSG,b.CREATE_USER,b.CREATE_DEPT,b.CREATE_TIME,b.UPDATE_USER,b.UPDATE_TIME)
mapper.update:
update BOK_SUBJECT
SUBJECT_NAME = #{subjectName},
FSUBJECT_ID = #{fsubjectId},
SUBJECT_TYPE = #{subjectType},
SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{subjectLevel},
BAL_FLAG = #{balFlag},
STATUS = #{status},
REMARK = #{remark},
UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser},
UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime}
SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}
AND BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_NO code,SUBJECT_NAME name,SUBJECT_NAME shortName,SUBJECT_NO hidCode,SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%'
order by SUBJECT_NO

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_LEVEL id, SUBJECT_LEVEL text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) >= ( select DISTINCT to_number(SUBJECT_LEVEL) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{search}
order by SUBJECT_LEVEL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL
select count(1) from BOK_SUBJECT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NAME id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%'
order by SUBJECT_NAME
select count(*) from BOK_SUBJECT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} AND STATUS IN ('A','E')

select count(*) from BOK_SUBJECT where (BOOKSET_ID,SUBJECT_NO) in
(#{item.BOOKSET_ID},#{item.SUBJECT_NO})
and STATUS in ('A','E')
